claim: A proof-runner identity cannot mint a session when its linked account has a role different from the trusted server-configured role.

evidenceBoundary.environment: local synthetic sealed-runtime extraction with persistent SQLite restart
evidenceBoundary.scale: one proof-runner key / one synthetic tenant / one pre-escalated linked account

red.observation: The configured manager account was changed to administrator before challenge exchange, retaining its existing costs access and gaining system.admin. The valid Ed25519 assertion returned HTTP 200 and created a proof-runner session instead of failing closed with HTTP 503.
red.rootCause: Trusted configuration bound key, email, tenant, routes and budgets but contained no expected account role. Issuance therefore snapshotted whatever role the linked email had at exchange time, including an unexpected privileged role.

repair.mandatoryExpectedRole: Each proof-runner key configuration now requires a syntactically validated role supplied only by trusted server configuration.
repair.issuanceFailClosed: After signature, audience, nonce and lifetime verification, the exchange requires exact email, tenant and role agreement before session creation; mismatch returns HTTP 503.
repair.noFalseEvidence: The mismatched-role test verifies that no proof-runner session and no proof-runner-session-issued audit event exist after rejection.
repair.ongoingRevocation: The existing issuance-time authority fingerprint continues to revoke already-issued sessions on any later role, costs or permission change.
repair.unchangedControls: Exact key binding, route intersection, monotonic limit contraction, replay denial, action budget, rate limit and kill switch remain enforced.

coverage: passkey Origin, user-verification and replay controls
proof-runner atomic rate/action budgets, scope denial, replay denial, audit and kill switch
proof-runner authority contraction across persistent restart

green.overlayIdempotence: The proof-runner hardener applied twice to a fresh sealed extraction and the resulting server plus both changed source files passed syntax validation.

excludedHarnessFailures: The first focused invocation omitted the explicit sealed-artifact path, so all five tests stopped with ENOENT before candidate execution.
The first affected-suite invocation omitted WFM_TEST_RUNTIME_ARCHIVE for one legacy test; nine reached tests passed and the tenth stopped at tar ENOENT before candidate execution.

releaseGate.reason: This result executed locally on Node 24.19.0 rather than required Node 22.23.2. Exact hosted configuration, role governance, all-instance propagation and identity-provider federation remain unproved.
releaseGate.nextProof: Execute the pre-escalated-account issuance attack inside the exact Node 22.23.2 Docker candidate, then prove a hosted synthetic manager-bound identity is denied before session creation when its account role is unexpectedly changed on every active instance.
